headline: PSD reports transferring black-box memory construction into small Qwen models
summary: A September 20 preprint introduces pseudo self-distillation (PSD), which uses outputs from a closed-model oracle as prompt context for a Qwen model acting as a privileged teacher, then trains a student to match its output distribution without access to teacher logits or hidden states. In the authors’ LoCoMo test, a PSD-trained Qwen3-4B receives an overall LLM-judge score of 0.8699 versus 0.849 for the original MEMORA pipeline using GPT-4.1-mini; the paper also reports improvements over its own SFT checkpoint at all three tested Qwen sizes. These are author-reported results. The reported score comparison does not establish total training-plus-inference cost savings.
